## What's new

**Security update.** CryptBridge works exactly as in 0.13.1.

### Windows

- **Built with Go 1.27.4**, which fixes a flaw in Go's own HTTP code (GO-2026-6859). CryptBridge talks to the cloud services and to GitHub over HTTPS, so updating is recommended.
- **Updated libraries:** `golang.org/x/crypto` 0.59.0 (fixes GO-2026-5932; CryptBridge did not use the affected code), `x/net`, `x/sys` and `x/text`.
- Your settings, vaults and the app lock stay as they are. rclone stays at 1.75.2.

### Linux server

- Nothing changed, only the version number.

### README

- A clear disclaimer: CryptBridge is free hobby software without any warranty. Keep backups of your important files and print every vault's emergency sheet.

## Updating

- **Windows:** quit CryptBridge (wait until no uploads are running), replace `CryptBridge.exe` with the new one and start it.
- **Server:** nothing to do. `sudo cryptbridge setup` is not needed for this version.

## Downloads

- `CryptBridge.exe`: Windows 11 (64-bit), needs [WinFsp](https://winfsp.dev/rel/)
- `setup.sh`: Linux server (Ubuntu / Debian)
- Backup copies (optional, see above): the four rclone ZIP files, `winfsp-2.1.25156.msi`, `rclone-LICENSE.txt`, `WinFsp-LICENSE.txt`
